findings.title: Fallback translations can remain stale after changing the site locale
findings.body: The fallback chain depends on `SiteSetting.default_locale`, but the translation cache in `translate_accelerator.rb` is keyed only by the requested locale and backend. If an administrator changes the default locale while the process is running, lookups already cached for a user locale continue returning translations resolved through the old default locale until those entries are evicted or the cache is reset. Include the fallback configuration in cache invalidation or otherwise clear affected entries when the setting changes.

findings.title: Fallback locales are loaded only for controller requests
findings.body: This is the only call site that loads the locales in the fallback chain. The translation accelerator loads only the active locale when `I18n.t` is called, while the fallback backend expects fallback locale translations to already be present. Translations invoked outside this controller filter—such as in background jobs, mailers, or other non-request code—therefore cannot fall back to the site default or English and may return missing translations. Ensure the fallback locales are loaded wherever translations can be performed, not only in this request filter.
